scope: One new A-only refined wall candidate. No tower B, publisher, runtime, Field, Physics, portal, water, save or formal write.

visual_goal.body: Ten finer staggered ashlar courses, normally sixteen stones across, with narrow real joints and restrained deterministic width/depth variation.
visual_goal.damage: A few geometry-level shallow recesses and small missing upper corners; not a bitmap edit and not uniform destruction.
visual_goal.parapet: Low parapet with narrow real arrow openings, a thin lintel course and fourteen low crenellations; avoids the previous tall square-tooth silhouette.
visual_goal.material: Retain the accepted weathered rock_01 plus project-original worn_bluestone blend, adding restrained low-frequency variation and a subtle damp foot zone.

geometry_contract.camera_unchanged: Frozen 30-degree orthographic capture inherited from native v1.

source_boundary.rock_01: Existing Poly Haven CC0-1.0 texture set already registered by the frozen gate art contract.
source_boundary.worn_bluestone_v2: Existing project-original builtin-imagegen texture with frozen generation record; not CC0 and not newly generated or edited.
source_boundary.architecture: Procedural project geometry; the complete gate architecture is not represented as CC0.
